description: Operator labels for the twelve w11 fallback rows: the status each row should be routed to, from the w11 vocabulary. Ground truth written by Mario Moreno, who does this triage as day work; the labels are the operator's judgment, not a model's. The rows and the vocabulary are invented.
method: One pass through all twelve rows on a labeling page that showed each row exactly as get_fallback_row returns it, plus the vocabulary with its meanings, and suggested nothing. Notes are the operator's, verbatim.
vocabulary: The w11 invented vocabulary, ten statuses, as served by get_status_vocabulary on 2026-10-21.

seen_model_output_before_labeling.why: A Claude Code client's routing for these four Discovery+ rows (claude-code-client-vocabulary-2026-10-21.txt, run B) was shown to the operator before labeling. The other eight rows were labeled with no model output seen. The labels agree with that run on 1 of the 4 (FB-1009).
